description: Deterministic release-gate contract for the PetTripFinder Phoenix / Scottsdale / Valley of the Sun market through PTF-PHOENIX-AZ-REGISTRATION-AND-STAGING-002. Every number is derived from THIS market's committed authority by release_contracts.derive_authority; none is typed and none is inherited from or comparable to another market's contract.

deployment_authorization.means: A passing contract means this market's assembled package is STRUCTURALLY deployable: its authority files agree, its routes match its reviewed inventory, no held identity leaks, and every publish gate holds. It is not a deployment authorization and asserts nothing about the market being complete -- 169 of this market's 484 registered identities are still unresolved, and no founder deployment decision exists for Phoenix at 256 published profiles.

identity_census.note: 484 registered identities, built from zero by PTF-PHOENIX-AZ-HARDENED-SOURCE-READY-001 on the Denver-live hardened lineage -- the first Arizona market -- and closed in that same order through the supported attended-browser lane (286 paced attempts, 254 first-party brand and property reads: every in-market Marriott route (106 attempts, 0 challenge denials), Hilton, Hyatt, Best Western, Sonesta, Drury, IHG, Omni, Red Roof and independents; no paid provider, no relay, no browser-JS exfiltration, no Akamai bypass and no CAPTCHA solved), registered by PTF-PHOENIX-AZ-REGISTRATION-AND-STAGING-002. Membership is this market's own corridor postal partition (census_membership_basis CORRIDOR_REGISTRY): 26 corridors over 130 admitted postal codes in the Valley of the Sun -- downtown, midtown and Biltmore/Camelback Phoenix, PHX Sky Harbor, Tempe, Old Town and Central Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, Mesa, Chandler and Glendale at CORE (11 CORE); Scottsdale Airpark/Kierland, North Scottsdale, Desert Ridge/Mayo, North Phoenix/Deer Valley, West Phoenix, Ahwatukee, Gilbert, Peoria, Goodyear/Avondale/Litchfield, Surprise/Sun City and Fountain Hills (11 CORRIDOR); and Queen Creek, Apache Junction/Gold Canyon, Buckeye and Cave Creek/Carefree (4 FRINGE). Scottsdale is inside this market, split into its own corridors by its own postal codes. SEDONA and the Verde Valley, FLAGSTAFF and the GRAND CANYON, PRESCOTT, TUCSON and southern Arizona, Payson and the White Mountains, Pinal County outside the contiguous East Valley, north-west Maricopa County, Yuma, Mohave County and every non-Arizona code are named, refused and preserved: 0 rows are admitted from a refused postal code. A name decides nothing: IHG and Marriott reuse five-letter codes here, so a code binds only under its own brand, and two brand codes at one address are two buildings (14 such buildings are held). Timeshare and vacation ownership, whole-home and unit rentals, condominium communities, RV resorts and serviced-apartment portfolios are never admitted, and a hotel whose own page says it has not opened never publishes. Rows the identity graph did not admit are recorded, not dropped: 112 IDENTITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED; 1034 NAME_ONLY_UNRESOLVED; 423 NON_LODGING; 440 OUTSIDE_MARKET; 4 SAME_CAMPUS_DISTINCT_ENTITY; 2 SAME_IDENTITY_REBRAND_SUCCESSOR.

reconciliation.note: 256 clean pet-friendly and 59 clean verified-no-pets over a 484-identity census. A row publishes only on an OPERATIVE first-party quote from the property's own page, bound to its census identity by the property code or the full street identity that page states: a fee, a weight, a count, an amenity chip or a service-animal sentence alone publishes nothing, one brand page that binds two census rows publishes for neither, and an identity the census cannot address never publishes. 169 identities did not publish (7 ACCESS_BLOCKED; 22 EVIDENCE_HOLD; 49 IDENTITY_MISMATCH_HOLD; 61 ROUTING_HOLD; 30 SOURCE_SILENT); every one is named in phoenix_az_clean_authority_001.json with its class. No gate was lowered to preserve a count.

policy_package.note: The verified hotel identities are DERIVED from this package at assembly time via site_data.verified_public_hotels(); they are not restated here. Every record carries the exact operator quote for each published fact, the capture lane, and the sha256 of the document it was read from.

final_partition.note: The partition of record for this market, referenced by path and content digest so the whole-site assembler resolves it from THIS contract rather than from a table in its own source. Written from the committed file by release_contracts.final_partition_block; verified by market_partition_resolution: the file must exist, declare this market_id, hash to expected_sha256 and carry expected_count identities. Regenerating the partition means reissuing this block.

public_surface.held_hotel_exclusion: Every seed hotel this market owns that is absent from the committed package (not-published seed hotels: held/manual-review plus rows still pending evidence) must have NO public route and NO reference on any surface: hotel profiles, the hotels listing/category page, nearby-lodging cards on any page, the policy-comparison table, the sitemap, canonicals, internal links, and /go/ interstitials. This market currently holds none -- every seed row it owns is published -- and the gate is derived, so it starts enforcing the moment that changes.

routes.note: route_mode market_prefixed: this market's hub, corridor and policy-comparison pages live under /pet-friendly-hotels/phoenix-az/. 18 of 26 corridors reach their own publication minimum; the rest are suppressed, which is a threshold and not a gap. The market and its corridors are hidden from navigation and the sitemap (show_in_navigation=false, show_in_sitemap=false) until a launch order says otherwise.

publish.note: The publish root must contain ONLY the static website plus the two Netlify control files. Build-internal reports the generator emits (_build_report.json, _broken_link_report.json, _quality_report.json, bundle_manifest.json) are read for gating but are excluded from site/ and must never ship.
